reason: The static gate sequence for Eventar is repeated every phase and its failure modes are recurring: stale generated type folders after next build, and heavy gates colliding. Nothing in the library covers it, so it gets a project skill.

The baseline is stale after K3. Two gate facts were learned the hard way: a load-induced test failure, and an em-dash copy breach caught only by self-review. Both are pre-commit checks that belong with the gate list.

Episode hit three vitest 5s timeouts in unrelated account/profile/invite files under peer load; they passed 78/78 when rerun alone. The skill covers the flake class but not the timeout signature or the isolated-rerun step.

Episode hit a 6-minute incremental tsc stall and a 2 GB OOM, traced to a gitignored stale tsbuildinfo and to supabase-js's inferred select row type. Both are non-obvious and the gate skill is where a future session will look first.

Full vitest run needs local-stack Supabase URL and keys. With no env, 46 DB-gated files fail at import with "supabaseUrl is required". Passing the local values as process env, plus an empty temp .env.local (tests/helpers/env.ts throws if the file is missing), gave 187 files passed and 46 skipped. The gate is green on the local stack, not on Seoul.

The em-dash scan flagged lines that were reshaped, not newly written: a header that already said "Times in HKT — <clock>" was rewritten with a variable zone and so matched the + filter. Scan results need a check of whether the copy is new or moved.

The recorded baseline is stale (2026-10-14). The 2026-10-16 run gave vitest 1501 passed and 404 skipped, eslint 12 problems (1 error, 11 warnings, all pre-existing), and next build 39 routes. The next session needs these numbers to read its delta.
